subtitle.en: Proof and reasoning, parallel lines, triangles and congruence, similarity, right-triangle trigonometry, circles, and area & volume. Eleven chapters, three explorers, 50 problems.

note.en: SAT includes geometry — official practice tests

downloadsInfo.introText: Take Geometry offline. The PDF packet prints straight from your browser; native Word versions with editable equation-editor math are available on request.
downloadsInfo.pdfCardDescription: All eight chapters plus every worked solution, formatted as a clean print document.

downloadsInfo.worksheetLibraryText: 85 real worksheets with answer keys, organized by unit — free to download and print.

testGenerator.introText: Build a randomised test from this subject’s question bank. Pick the number of questions and a difficulty, generate, then reveal the worked answers when you’re ready — or print a clean copy to hand out.
